age.Description: Age of each participant in years.

gender.Description: Self-reported gender of each participant, one of Man, Women, or Other.

nationality.Description: Whether each participant was raised in a predominantly English-speaking or Non English-speaking country.

runs_included.Description:
The number of runs included in the analysis, including derivatives files. 
Mostly equal to 8, but for some participants the final two runs were excluded due to head motion or low attention. 
Equal to 0 for participants who failed attention checks and so were excluded completely.
